name: CSS Observer
note: R13.18, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.44 (PDF p.45). The Destroyer rebuilt around special sensors, and the owner called both the chassis and the split price before the sheet was opened. POINT VALUE = 126/90, read the way the CVE's 100/90 was: the SMALLER number is the BPV and the larger is the EPV. That split is not decoration here - FleetValidator costs a SCOUT at its ECONOMIC value rather than its BPV, so 126 is what this ship actually spends from a fleet budget, and recording only the 90 would have made it cheap by a third. FOUR SPECIAL SENSOR BOXES, two forward and one on each flank, declared as ScoutChannel weapons with dacHitLocation 'torp' - which is the sheet's own 'SPECIAL SENSORS ARE DESTROYED ON TORPEDO DAMAGE POINTS' (G24.17). Nothing else needs saying to make this a scout: Ship.isScout is simply whether it has channels, so declaring them earns it the G24 functions, the EPV costing above and S8.25's free scout slot. THE PLASMA IS GONE ENTIRELY. The Destroyer carries two plasma-F at FP and two more from its PL-F refit; this hull carries none, and has four sensor boxes where they stood - which is why the DAC location for those boxes is the torpedo row, and why there is no PL-F refit on the sheet and none here. The chassis is otherwise the DD's exactly, counted box by box: shields 20 all round, C hull 10, warp 8 a side, impulse 2, APR 2, batteries 4, labs 4, bridge 2, emergency 1, aux 1, transporters 2, tractors 2, one probe, four shuttle boxes, excess damage 4, turn mode B, and every damage track. Crew 22 against the DD's 24, boarding parties 8 the same. The sheet carries the whole SCOUT FUNCTIONS SUMMARY, G24.21 to G24.29, of which five are built - see project_scout_functions for which. No refits at all: with no plasma there is no PL-F refit, and the Y180 Sabot refit is a plasma refit, so neither line appears on the sheet.
